name: Ketkout OP1
about: Ketkout no Koe, a bittersweet anime ending song made in Jam: the song, its sung Japanese lyrics with romaji, four LTX-2.5 scenes of Ketkout in blue ink, and the edit that cuts them on the beat with karaoke captions.

track.name: Ketkout no Koe
track.prompt: A bittersweet Japanese anime ending song, intimate and nostalgic with a quiet sense of hope. Melodic J-pop ballad built around a warm piano, clean electric guitar with gentle delay, soft acoustic guitar, melodic electric bass, and a restrained live drum kit. A clear, expressive female lead vocal sings in Japanese with a youthful but natural tone, delicate in the verses and fuller in the chorus; preserve breaths and subtle imperfections, without exaggerated vibrato or heavy pitch correction. Begin with a few seconds of piano and distant guitar, like watching the last light disappear from a train window. Keep the first verse sparse, with piano and a soft pulse of bass. In the pre-chorus, introduce rising strings and a gentle drum build. Let the chorus bloom into wide guitars, flowing drums and understated harmonies, carrying a memorable melody that feels like a promise between friends. Pull the arrangement back briefly for the bridge, then return to a final chorus with a little more warmth and vocal harmony. End gently with piano and a ringing guitar note, leaving a feeling of gratitude and unfinished adventures. Natural dynamics, clear Japanese diction, warm stereo mix, soft reverb, no spoken dialogue, no crowd noise, no abrupt ending.
track.lyrics:
[intro]
[SOFT PIANO AND CLEAN GUITAR]

[verse]
茜色に染まる　帰り道で
君の影が　少し伸びていた
言えなかった言葉　ポケットの中
握りしめて　空を見上げた

いつかこの景色も　変わるのかな
違う明日へ　歩き出しても
今日の笑い声が　胸の奥で
小さな灯りに　なっている

[pre-chorus]
さよならの練習なんて
まだしなくていいから
もう少しだけ　このままで
同じ風を感じて

[chorus]
またね　またね　遠く離れても
君と見た空は　消えないから
こぼれそうな涙の向こうに
僕らの明日が　待っている

忘れないよ　名前を呼ぶ声も
不器用な夢も　あの日の約束も
夜が来ても　星を探すように
君を思い出すよ

[instrumental]
[CLEAN GUITAR MELODY OVER PIANO AND STRINGS]

[bridge]
もしも迷って　立ち止まる夜は
あの歌を　そっと口ずさもう
聞こえなくても　届かなくても
同じ空が　つながってる

[final chorus]
またね　またね　季節が巡っても
君といた日々は　ここにあるよ
何気ない一秒のすべてが
僕らを明日へ　連れてゆく

ありがとうを　まだ言えないまま
手を振る君に　僕も笑った
夜が来ても　星を探すように
また会えると信じて

[outro]
またね　またね
明日へ続く空の下

[PIANO AND GUITAR FADE GENTLY]
